title: WeAreDevs Obfuscator API
script:
local WeAreDevs = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://gist.githubusercontent.com/Polinorsik/9d84eebd6aa9ac56f4835465360a8651/raw/d405feb9a4d744940572b60aae4afce6f6009e8d/WeAreDevs"))()
--[[
    How to use:
    if you know luau then use this functions with first args it script like
    [
        local result = WeAreDevs:Obfuscate([=[print("Hello, World!")]=])
        print(result)
    ]
    
    to copy:
    [
        local result = WeAreDevs:Obfuscate([=[print("Hello, World!")]=])
        setclipboard(result)
    ]
]]
